## Change

Added `SuppressRedirectedActivityViews` middleware. It records a one-use, server-side session marker only when a Q&A action redirects to that same session page or an administrator calendar mutation redirects to the calendar. The following matching GET consumes the marker and skips only its view event. Direct and later visits still log. The marker is not set for unrelated redirect destinations. No database schema, historical log, action event, access check, or authorization behavior changed.

- `application/source/app/Http/Middleware/SuppressRedirectedActivityViews.php` (new)
- `application/source/bootstrap/app.php`
